claims.claim: The parameter defaults are gid_index=-1, use_gid_user=0 and IPv4 preference; on an Ethernet link check_link changes an unset gid_index to 0 without marking it user-selected, causing set_up_connection to use automatic selection.

Automatic selection scores requested address-family match by 100, non-link-local scope by 10, and RoCE version by at most 9; the declared weights make address family dominate scope and scope dominate RoCE version, with v2 rated above v1.
A GID query failure or all-zero GID scores -1 and is skipped; get_best_gid_index scans the table and retains the first index with a strictly greater score, returning -1 when no valid entry exists.
Supplying -x/--gid-index sets use_gid_user=1, so set_up_connection queries that exact index and bypasses get_best_gid_index; --ipv6 changes only the automatic family preference.

Failure to select or query a GID makes set_up_connection return -1; write_bw reports setup failure and enters destroy/free cleanup, while a selected index is later installed as the GRH sgid_index for global addressing.
